description: This file contains C++ class definitions for JSON data structures used in the WPEFramework's Controller JSON-RPC API. It defines various parameter and result classes for API methods, including plugin activation, cloning, data broadcasting, file downloading, discovery, state changes, subsystem management, and hibernation control.

classes.name: ActivateParamsInfo
classes.description: Holds parameters for plugin activation, specifically the plugin's callsign.

classes.name: CloneParamsInfo
classes.description: Contains parameters for cloning a plugin, including the original and new callsigns.

classes.name: AllParamsData
classes.description: Represents data broadcasted as an event, including the originator's callsign and the data object.

classes.name: DeleteParamsData
classes.description: Holds the path to a directory to delete contents within.

classes.name: DownloadParamsData
classes.description: Contains source URL, destination path, and hash for a file download operation.

classes.name: DownloadcompletedParamsData
classes.description: Represents the result of a download operation, including success status, source, and destination.

classes.name: StartdiscoveryParamsData
classes.description: Holds the TTL parameter for SSDP discovery.

classes.name: StatechangeParamsData
classes.description: Contains information about a plugin state change, including callsign, new state, and reason.

classes.name: SubsystemsParamsData
classes.description: Represents subsystem name and its active status.

classes.name: HibernateParamsInfo
classes.description: Contains parameters for hibernation control, including callsign, timeout, and process sequence.
